 PGA Tour Highlights: 2026 RSM Classic, Round 2 
 Relive the biggest moments and top shots from the second round of the 2026 RSM Classic! 
 The RSM Classic continues Saturday on rainy Sea Island, Georgia, leaving 36 holes for players to earn 2027 PGA Tour cards.
 Live coverage airs on Golf Channel and Golf Channel mobile from 1-4 p.m. EST, with “Golf Central Postgame” wrapping the day.
 The RSM marks the end to the Tour’s fall season with the top 100 in FedExCup points earning full status next year.
 Michael Thorbjornsen, Marco Penge and Rasmus Neergaard-Petersen co-lead at 9 under. Six players are tied for fourth, one shot back.
